whyLargestVisibleGap: The only gap measured directly on the brief's named metrics, and the largest: desktop edge chroma 63.13 vs the Target's 35.91 (+76%), fringe R-B axis 59.46 vs 34.98 (+70%), white reflection ratio 0.144 vs the Target's 0.204 (-30%).
